summary: Iteration 79 backend-only regression covering (A) Zami session e-mail spam fix, (B) 48h transit visa removal, (C) new VIP desert safari product. 18/20 tests PASS. Two failures are a NEW REAL BUG in the store order path: POST /api/orders neither enforces nor persists scheduled_date/scheduled_time for needs_schedule=true tour products (affects both tour_desert_safari and tour_desert_safari_vip). All (A) session-alert tests pass and mongo email_outbox confirms zero new zami_session_expired records since the fix was deployed (~15:02 UTC) despite multiple backend restarts and keepalive_tick firing with reason='otp_required_pending' at 15:08 and 15:12 — the persistent cooldown works as designed.

critical.issue: Tour products with needs_schedule=true (tour_desert_safari, tour_desert_safari_vip) can be ordered WITHOUT scheduled_date/scheduled_time and returns 200 — schedule validation is completely bypassed. Also, when scheduled_date/scheduled_time are supplied on the item, they are silently dropped: OrderItemIn in /app/backend/routes_store.py has only product_id + quantity, and _build_order_line() never calls _tour_schedule() (which lives only in routes_public.py and is only invoked by the application flow). Result: the customer's chosen safari date/time never reaches the database, and the admin sees an order with no schedule information. Fix suggestion: (1) add optional scheduled_date/scheduled_time fields to OrderItemIn, (2) import & call _tour_schedule from routes_public inside routes_store._build_order_line (or move the helper to a shared module), (3) enforce raise HTTPException(400) when needs_schedule=true and either field is missing.

minor.issue: logger.warning('zami session expired (%s) - admin bilgilendirildi', ...) fires on line 265 even when _warn_admin_session_expired early-returns for OTP_FLOW_REASONS or is suppressed by cooldown. The log message wrongly claims admin was informed. Cosmetic but misleading during triage — consider having _warn_admin_session_expired return a bool so the caller only logs when a send actually happened.
Iter_78 already noted: mismatched/missing email returns 404 (same as not-found) hiding validation errors.

action_items: Fix POST /api/orders schedule handling: extend OrderItemIn with optional scheduled_date/scheduled_time and enforce/persist them for products where needs_schedule=true. Currently the entire /api/orders tour-booking flow silently drops the schedule; only the /api/applications flow validates it. Retest with test_iteration_79.py::TestVipSafari after fix.
Optional: fix the misleading WARNING log in zami_status._keepalive_tick (see minor issue).
test_zami_session_alerts.py was rewritten to match repo style (asyncio.run helper on a single reused loop; no pytest-asyncio dependency). It now passes 5/5.
critical_code_review_comments: _tour_schedule (routes_public.py:392) is dead code for direct /api/orders traffic — it must be reused by routes_store._build_order_line or moved into store_catalog to avoid drift.

In zami_status._keepalive_tick, the local `warned` boolean is now redundant now that _warn_admin_session_expired has its own persistent cooldown via settings_col. Consider removing the in-memory `warned` return value to keep a single source of truth for cooldown state.

The `warned` state in keepalive_loop is a local variable that resets on every loop restart anyway — the persistent settings-based cooldown is what actually enforces the 12h rule. Simplify by dropping the parameter.

test_iteration_79.py::test_application_with_transit_visa_rejected observed the app rejects visa_transit_48 — verify at code level: the rejection happens because visa_type_id lookup fails (no entry with id visa_transit_48 exists in VISA_TYPES). If VISA_TYPES override in DB ever holds a stale visa_transit_48 doc, this test would silently break — consider explicit deny-list in the validator.
seed_data_creation: Created one store order for tour_desert_safari_vip (SV-...) with TEST_vip_ok_* email; a couple of application-schema TEST_ payloads were rejected by validation. Mutated settings.zami_session.value.expired_notified_at during test_warn_writes_persistent_timestamp and test_cooldown_blocks_repeat_warning but each test restores the original value in a finally block. Confirmed via post-run inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_zami_session_alerts.py (5 tests, uses a single persistent event loop to avoid Motor closed-loop errors) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_79.py (10 tests). After main agent fixes the /api/orders schedule bug, re-run: `pytest tests/test_iteration_79.py::TestVipSafari -v`. All 4 (B) transit-removal tests pass and confirm 7 visa types, 7 guides, no transit-vize, and application POST is rejected. Email_outbox verification for (A): the last real zami_session_expired e-mail is dated 2026-09-05 14:56 UTC (pre-fix); zero new records after that timestamp despite multiple restarts and OTP-flow keepalive ticks — fix works.

rca of the issue.A_email_spam: Root cause was an IN-MEMORY `warned` boolean in zami_status.keepalive_loop that reset on every backend restart, combined with keepalive_tick calling _warn_admin_session_expired for OTP-flow states that are already covered by otp_reminders.py. Fix (verified passing): OTP_FLOW_REASONS early-return + persistent 12h cooldown via settings_col.zami_session.value.expired_notified_at / otp_reminder_sent_at. Confirmed by mongodb email_outbox: 20+ sends before fix, 0 after fix.
rca of the issue.C_schedule_bug_new: POST /api/orders in routes_store.py never validates or persists scheduled_date/scheduled_time. OrderItemIn model lacks those fields, and _build_order_line skips needs_schedule handling. The /api/applications flow uses a separate resolve_store_lines/_tour_schedule path in routes_public.py that does enforce it. Repro: `curl -X POST {BASE}/api/orders -d '{items:[{product_id:tour_desert_safari_vip,quantity:1}],contact:...}` returns 200. Mitigation: mirror _tour_schedule call inside routes_store._build_order_line and add scheduled_* fields to OrderItemIn.
